sentences.s: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent

trunk.主干翻译: 这场迁移造就了一个民族。

components.成分类型: 非谓语作状语(过去分词)
components.原文: driven by powerful and diverse motivations
components.中文翻译: 在各种强大动机的推动下
components.说明: 过去分词短语作状语，插在主谓之间，修饰全句，译时提至句首表原因。
介词短语作状语，说明造就民族的起点。

components.原文: and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent
components.中文翻译: 并循其本质塑造了一片全新大陆的特点，决定了它的命运
components.说明: and 连接的并列谓语，与 built 共用主语 This movement。
介词短语作状语，意为就这场迁移的本质而言。

sentences.zh: 在各种强大动机的推动下，这场迁移从荒野中造就了一个民族，并循其本质塑造了一片全新大陆的特点，决定了它的命运。

sentences.s: The United States is the product of two principal forces—the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics and the impact of a new country which modified these traits

trunk.宾语或表语: the product of two principal forces
trunk.主干翻译: 合众国是两股主要力量作用的产物。

components.原文: the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics
components.中文翻译: 具有不同思想、风俗和民族特点的欧洲各民族的迁入
components.说明: 破折号后第一个同位语，说明 two principal forces 之一。

components.原文: the impact of a new country which modified these traits
components.中文翻译: 一个新国家因改变了这些特性而产生的影响
components.说明: and 连接的第二个同位语，说明 two principal forces 之二。

components.原文: with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics
components.中文翻译: 具有不同思想、风俗和民族特点
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语，修饰 European peoples。
which 引导的定语从句作后置定语，修饰 a new country。

sentences.zh: 合众国是两股主要力量作用的产物——一是具有不同思想、风俗和民族特点的欧洲各民族的迁入，二是一个新国家因改变了这些特性而产生的影响。

sentences.s: But, the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes

trunk.主语: the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent
trunk.主干翻译: 所有这一切引起了意义深远的变化。

components.原文: the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America
components.中文翻译: 美洲特有地理条件的作用

components.原文: the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another
components.中文翻译: 不同族群间的相互影响

components.原文: the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent
components.中文翻译: 在一片荒蛮新大陆上维持旧大陆方式的巨大困难
components.说明: and 连接的第三个并列主语。
形容词短语作后置定语，peculiar to 意为特有的。

components.原文: maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent
components.中文翻译: 在一片荒蛮新大陆上维持旧大陆方式
components.说明: 动名词短语作 of 的宾语，修饰 difficulty。

sentences.zh: 但是美洲特有地理条件的作用，不同族群间的相互影响，加上在一片荒蛮新大陆上维持旧大陆方式的巨大困难，所有这一切引起了意义深远的变化。

sentences.s: The first shiploads of immigrants bound for the territory which is now the United States crossed the Atlantic more than a hundred years after the 15 th-and-16 th-century explorations of North America

trunk.主干翻译: 首批满载移民的船只横穿过了大西洋。

components.成分类型: 非谓语作定语(过去分词)
components.原文: bound for the territory which is now the United States
components.中文翻译: 驶向今天合众国这片疆土的
components.说明: 过去分词短语 bound for 作后置定语，修饰 shiploads。

components.原文: which is now the United States
components.说明: which 引导的定语从句，修饰 the territory。

components.原文: more than a hundred years after the 15 th-and-16 th-century explorations of North America
components.中文翻译: 在十五、十六世纪的北美大陆探险过去一百多年后
components.说明: 介词短语作时间状语，译时提至句首。

sentences.zh: 在十五、十六世纪的北美大陆探险过去一百多年后，首批满载移民驶向今天合众国这片疆土的船只横穿过了大西洋。

sentences.s: The virgin forest with its richness and variety of trees was a real treasure-house which extended from Maine all the way down to Georgia

trunk.主干翻译: 原始森林是一座真正的宝库。

components.原文: with its richness and variety of trees
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语，修饰 The virgin forest。

components.原文: which extended from Maine all the way down to Georgia
components.中文翻译: 从缅因州一直向南延伸至佐治亚州
components.说明: which 引导的定语从句，修饰 a real treasure-house。

components.原文: from Maine all the way down to Georgia
components.中文翻译: 从缅因州一直向南延伸至佐治亚州
components.说明: 介词短语作状语，说明宝库延伸的范围。

sentences.zh: 郁郁葱葱、树种繁多的原始森林是一座真正的宝库，它从缅因州一直向南延伸至佐治亚州。
